o.text: Etymologically from toxu- + -uş. Ultimately derived from Proto-Turkic *tokï- (“to weave”). Cognate with Turkish tokuşmak.
Izafet II compound of nitq + hissə. Ultimately, calque of Latin pars orationis.
Borrowed from Russian кно́пка (knópka), ultimately from German Knopf + Russian -ка (-ka).
